title: Bounded Worker Pipeline with Graceful Shutdown
instructions: Implement `Result` and `Pipeline` in `pipeline.py`. A fixed pool of worker threads reads from a bounded `queue.Queue`; `submit` returns sequence numbers and applies backpressure, and `close()` drains the queue, stops the workers with one sentinel each, and returns the results sorted by `seq`. Exceptions from `fn` are captured per item, and no accepted item may be lost when `submit` races with `close`.

evidence.label: Results come back in submission order
Captures errors per item and keeps going
Raises queue.Full on timeout without using up a sequence number
submit blocks while the queue is full
close() waits for queued items and returns every result
submit after close raises PipelineClosed; close is idempotent
close() stops and joins the worker threads
Concurrent producers lose nothing and get unique ordered sequence numbers
Racing submit and close never loses an accepted item
Result is a frozen, slotted dataclass
